payload.value:
APNs + FCM are exported/documented; Web Push is partially public but still incomplete.

- Web Push adapter validates PushSubscription JSON, is exported from the main @frick/server entrypoint, and can read VAPID credentials from tenant_settings.push.webPush.encrypted via the admin route. It still lacks a package subpath export and `frick tenants set-push --platform webPush` CLI provisioning (push-adapters.md; status.md).
- Web Push deliberately sends an empty body — encrypted Web Push payloads (AES-128-GCM envelope) are follow-up (push-adapters.md).
- Push credential rotation requires re-saving every tenant credentials; no multi-key overlap/decryption window (push-adapters.md).

Target: documented Web Push subpath export + CLI provisioning, encrypted payloads, zero-downtime multi-key rotation.
